text:
ashok: Hey folks — planning AKV integration for a cross-tenant service. Questions: can a managed identity from tenant A call a key in tenant B? Also deciding RBAC vs access policies for crypto ops, and how we should ship audit logs for compliance. TL;DR: what's the recommended pattern?

maria: Short answer: user-assigned / system-assigned MIs are tenant-scoped. They won't authenticate in a different tenant. For cross-tenant you need a service principal (app registration) in the target tenant or use an outbound API in the same tenant as the KV.

maria: For RBAC vs access policies — RBAC is the newer model and fits better for least privilege + central role assignments. Access policies still work but are more static and per-vault. If you want group-based roles or AAD Conditional Access, pick RBAC.

kevin: FWIW we switched new vaults to RBAC in dev and kept a couple legacy vaults on access policies. Watch out: some platform SDKs assume access policies for key-wrap ops — test the client lib you plan to use.

sophia: Audit log side: enable Diagnostic Settings on the KV and stream AuditEvent to Log Analytics + an immutable storage account (for retention) AND to Event Hub if you need SIEM downstream. Compliance usually wants immutable export for >= 1 year.

ashok: Helpful. Example az commands for RBAC + diagnostics?

maria: Sure — enable RBAC (vault-level):
```
az keyvault update --name my-kv --resource-group rg-platform --set properties.enableRbacAuthorization=true
```
Assign role to an app/service principal:
```
az role assignment create --assignee <SPN-or-ObjectId> --role "Key Vault Crypto User" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/rg-platform/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/my-kv
```
Diagnostic settings sample:
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings create --name kv-diagnostics --resource "/subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/rg-platform/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/my-kv" --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]' --workspace /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/rg-logs/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/kv-logs
```

kevin: Note: AuditEvent contains key operations (encrypt/decrypt/wrapKey/unwrapKey). If you need the actual signer principal, check the fields in the event schema — sometimes we needed additional parsing to map appId -> owner.

maria: On envelope encryption & rotation: keep data keys (DEK) in your storage/service, encrypted by KEK in AKV. Rotation: create a new key version in KV, then rewrap (decrypt/encrypt) the DEKs to new key version. Do NOT rotate KEK blindly — coordinate TTL + rewrap job.

sophia: Also enable key versioning when you create keys. Implement a background worker that rewraps stale DEKs and mark records with key version metadata. That way a rollout/rollback is easier.

ashok: Any gotchas for purge-protection/soft-delete?

maria: Enable soft-delete + purge-protection for production vaults. If someone accidentally deletes a key version and you rely on automatic rewraps, you could be in trouble. Purge-protection prevents deletion for the retention window.

kevin: Cross-tenant caveat: if you *must* access a KV across tenants and cannot deploy into the same tenant, use a service principal in the KV tenant with certificate-based auth and rotate creds via our secrets rotation pipeline. Do not try to share managed identities across tenants.

ashok: About compliance: do we need to store raw audit events off-cluster? The regulator asked for WORM storage.

sophia: Yes — push diagnostic export to an immutable storage account (Blob with immutability policy) and keep moderate retention in Log Analytics for queries. Event Hub -> SIEM for near-real-time alerts.

security-bot: (runbook) See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/akv-integration — includes checklist: RBAC toggle, diagnostic settings, KEK rotation playbook, cross-tenant SP onboarding, and required IAM roles.

maria: Final tip: test end-to-end with a staging tenant that mirrors RBAC setup and diagnostic sinks. Simulate key rotation and data-key rewraps before hitting prod.

ashok: Great — I'll prototype with a SPN+certificate in a staging tenant, enable RBAC on a new vault, wire diag to log analytics + storage, and post results. Thanks! :thumbsup:
